title: Sequoia shutting down its Scouts program marks the end of an era

claims.claim: Sequoia announced a broad overhaul including closing its London office and shutting down its scout program in a memo posted to X this week.

evidence.quote: Sequoia this week announced a broad overhaul in a memo posted to X, a move that includes closing its London office and shutting down its scout program.

claims.claim: Sequoia pioneered the scouts model 17 years ago.

evidence.quote: That’s partly because 17 years ago, Sequoia pioneered the scouts model, in which select founders and operators write checks on the firm’s behalf.
That’s partly because 17 years ago, Sequoia pioneered the scouts model

claims.claim: VC Sheel Mohnot wrote on X this week that the scout program never made sense to him and that scouts do not really care about the investments.

evidence.quote: “They pioneered the scout program but [to be honest] it never made sense to me!” VC Sheel Mohnot wrote on X this week. “The scouts themselves don’t really care that much about the investments

claims.claim: Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) partner Gabriel Vasquez told TechCrunch earlier this year that the firm had revamped its global scout program to double down on the best people.

evidence.quote: Rival firm Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), for instance, rolled out a global scout network aimed at spotting opportunities in the U.S. and also in smaller European hubs. But a16z partner Gabriel Vasquez told TechCrunch earlier this year that the firm had revamped its program to double down “on the best people.”

claims.claim: Station F boss Roxanne Varza served as a Sequoia scout from 2020 to 2025.

evidence.quote: Varza, a former Sequoia scout from 2020 to 2025, told TechCrunch that she had no information beyond what has been shared publicly

claims.claim: Roxanne Varza wrote on LinkedIn that she was sad to hear that Sequoia's scout program was getting cut off and hoped that other funds would not follow suit.

evidence.quote: Among them is Station F boss Roxanne Varza, who wrote on LinkedIn that she was “sad” to hear that the program was getting cut off, and “hope[d] that other funds [w]on’t follow suit.”
